bull.b: No debt reduces near-term leverage and interest-burden risk, while positive equity provides a financial base for continued development. Although funding needs remain, this cleaner balance sheet gives CalciMedica more flexibility than a highly leveraged clinical-stage company.

Auxora’s focus on calcium signaling across acute and inflammatory conditions creates potential for a broader development pathway than a single-indication program. Progress in one targeted disease area could also support expansion into related indications sharing the same biological mechanism.

Restored Nasdaq compliance removes an immediate listing-status obstacle and supports continued access to public equity markets. Maintaining a listed venue can help the company raise capital, retain market visibility, and preserve flexibility while advancing its clinical programs.

bear.b: The absence of revenue means CalciMedica currently lacks an operating stream to fund research, clinical execution, or corporate costs. Sustained EBIT and net losses leave financial performance dependent on future development success and external financing rather than self-generated earnings.

Ongoing cash consumption reduces the resources available to advance Auxora and other programs without additional funding. Even though burn improved versus 2025, persistently negative free cash flow indicates that the company remains dependent on capital markets until revenue or major cost reductions emerge.

An ATM facility improves financing access but can increase the share count as capital is raised, diluting existing holders. Its size relative to the company’s development-stage operations also underscores continued reliance on equity financing to support liquidity and corporate activities.
